p: On the table in the house north of the Observatory
sc: The astronomy book, or The Tale of Scorpius, is obtained during the Observatory Quest.

r: Completion of The Eyes of Glouphrie and Plague's End
sc: It is made by Crystal Singing at the crystal bowl in the Ithell Clan district of Prifddinas at the cost of an attuned crystal armour seed and 1,000 harmonic dust.
Attuned portent of restoration VIII is a portent created with level 77 Divination and level 80 Constitution using 50 lustrous energy and 1 shark or using 8 memory shards, yielding 15.

The Third Age-dyed augmented off-hand Ascension crossbow is a level 90 Ranged off-hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a off-hand Ascension crossbow (Third Age), or by using Third age dye on an augmented off-hand Ascension crossbow.
It can be made by using an augmentor on a staff of Sliske (Third Age), or by using Third Age dye on an augmented Staff of Sliske.

Aurora Greaves.x: Aurora Greaves is a legs slot cosmetic override. It is part of the Aurora set.

sc: The Aurora Off-Hand Warhammer is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 32 of the Wintumber Aurora Yak Track.
The avocado wrap is a food item available from the Squeal of Fortune between 5 May and 13 May 2013, and again in 2019 during the Summer Escape event.
It is made by combining a plain wrap and avocado sauce.
It is made by using ogre bellows with swamp gas on a swamp toad, receiving a bloated toad.

Using an usual rock to make the balloon toad will give a slightly different item than when using the grey rock found while mining limestone rock — the colours of the rock will be slightly different, but they are functionally equivalent.
They are dropped by General Graardor and his sergeants in the God Wars Dungeon.

Benchsitting cape.x: A Benchsitting cape is an item that players could receive from Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park after having reached level 99 in the Benchsitting skill during the 2024 April Fools event.

sc: The beta scientist torso is a piece of the Beta scientist outfit that can be claimed from Diango for completing 4 out of the possible 8 combat beta weekend events.
The black mushroom is an item that can be found growing in shaded areas inside the Uzer Ruins and in the goblin cave.
The quickest way to obtain them is by teleporting to the Dominion Tower and running east; or otherwise getting there via Fairy ring with code , then walking north-east.
The stew is made by cooking uncooked stew on a range or fire, requiring level 75 Cooking and learning how to make Bog 'n' Hog stew from Waterface in Linbog Village.

h: First time becoming available to Ironman Mode players.

sc: They can be made at a forge and anvil using 6 primal bars and primal platelegs + 1, requiring 3,300 progress to complete, granting a total of 8,400 Smithing experience.
Glass lenses for the frames can be made with level 49 Crafting by blowing glass; however, a cut sapphire can be used in place of the lens (with the same Crafting requirement).
Lamp oil, obtained by distilling swamp tar at the chemist's house in Rimmington, is used to fuel bullseye lanterns.
Bunny Ears are a head slot cosmetic override that could originally have been purchased for 38 egg points at the Egg Hunter's Hoard shop.
It is created by using camouflage potions on a potion flask.
The flask is made by blowing robust glass, requiring 89 Crafting and giving 100 experience.
Red sandstone can be mined at Oo'glog and smelted using the robust glass machine also located at Oo'glog.
Caramel Canine is a pet that can be purchased for 3,000 spring tokens at the The Grand Eggs-change shop.

Circus (Clown) Shirt.x: The Circus (Clown) Shirt is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be obtained through Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza as part of the Circus (Clown) outfit. It is unlocked alongside its item version.

sc: Clean fellstalk is a high-level herb, obtained by cleaning a grimy fellstalk, requiring level 91 Herblore and giving 16.
They are made by combining infernal magic incense sticks with a clean fellstalk, requiring level 91 Firemaking and giving 182.
Clue scroll (easy) is a simple clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.

Clue scroll (hard) - C ON GAME HOC.x: Clue scroll (hard) is an anagram clue obtained from hard sealed clue scrolls. It contains a clue to solve Treasure Trails.

sc: The collector's insignia is a reward from Barbarian Assault that can be purchased with 500 collector honour points if players are a level five collector and have at least five Penance King kills to use in the rewards shop.

Combat flask.x: The is a potion flask containing six doses of potion. It is created by using potions on a potion flask. Only the six-dose flask is tradeable on the Grand Exchange, but lower-dose versions can still be traded directly with other players.

sc: It is made by Olaf Hradson when the player presents him with some windswept logs from the windswept tree near where Olaf is.

r: Completion of The Eyes of Glouphrie and Plague's End
tx: Players may use a crystal fishing rod anywhere a fishing rod, fly fishing rod, or barbarian rod can be used:
sc: The rod can be re-crafted with a crystal tool seed and 150 harmonic dust at a singing bowl.
Crystal Peacock Weapons is a cosmetic override set that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked by redeeming a RuneScape Membership Card or by being a Premier Club member from 1 October to 31 October 2016.

u: Augmented pickaxe of earth and song
sc: The pickaxe is obtained by trading a dragon pickaxe and 4,000 harmonic dust to Lady Ithell in the Ithell district of Prifddinas (also requiring Plague's End).
Even though the mining requirement is level 70, the pickaxe can only be obtained in Prifddinas after finishing Plague's End which has a non-boostable requirement of 75 mining.
Cursed willow logs are logs obtained from cutting cursed willow roots used in the Summer's End quest.
The roots can be found within the caves north of the Abandoned Farm in the Wilderness.
Desert camouflage hands are an item that can be made with 3,600 camouflage fragments; previously, it could be won from Treasure Hunter.
They could be obtained by giving another player a Gift of Giving.
It is unlocked by inspecting the Dojo Mojo pet, found while training Agility.

Elf-style wig (green, male).x: The green elf-style wig is part of the elven outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Feathered serpent skirt (brown).x: The brown feathered serpent skirt is part of the feathered serpent outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: It is made by firing a Fragile mining urn (unfired) in a pottery oven or at a portable crafter, requiring level 17 Crafting and giving 31.
Globetrotter arm guards are a part of the globetrotter outfit which can be bought from Zaida in the Treasure Trails Reward Shop for 750 points.
The Gloves of Spades are a hands slot cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the King and Queen of Spades Pack.
The gold pentagon key is a key found in Daemonheim while training the Dungeoneering skill.
Only one gold pentagon key can be found in a single dungeon.
It can be purchased from the rewards trader for 22,500 Dungeoneering tokens.
The greater lumberjack aura is a tier 2 aura that can be bought from the Solomon's General Store for 14,000 Loyalty Points.
The previous aura of this set must be owned before this can be purchased.

Green partyhat (2018 April Fools).x: Green partyhat is an item that can be found on the ground at various locations around Gielinor. When the player attempts to pick one up, they receive a ring of rares instead accompanied with the message: You cast the partyhat aside and pick up a precious ring you find underneath it instead.

Group Ironman armour 4.x: Group Ironman armour 4 is a cosmetic override outfit only available to Group Ironman Mode players. It is unlocked by completed the achievement Journey Tier 10, and is removed if ironman mode is disabled.

Guardian of Fortitude cape.x: The Guardian of Fortitude cape is a cosmetic override unlockable in the Travelling Artisan (October 2020) event. The cape is part of the Guardian of Fortitude outfit.

s: Burthorpe; can be accessed via Showdown Sigil
Burthorpe; can also be accessed via Tumeken Sigils
sc: Herald of Tumeken Helmet is a cosmetic override outfit that is unlocked through the Desert Showdown promotion from Treasure Hunter.
It can be purchased with 5 Tumeken Sigils.
A Herblore XP lamp is an experience lamp awarded upon completion of Heroes' Quest.
It can be purchased for 99,000 coins along with the Firemaking hood from Ignatius Vulcan at Seers' Village by players who have achieved level 99 in Firemaking.

v: Only during Land of the Goblins and if the player doesn't already have the item.
sc: To obtain the key the player must first go to the Goblin Cave and turn into a goblin using a goblin potion.

The player must then wear purple goblin mail in order to be able to access the Horogothgar goblin tribe's area in the cave, and can then pickpocket the Horogothgar priest to obtain the Horogothgar key required to continue the quest.

p: In the oratory in Cithadere Abbey
sc: It can be obtained by searching in abbey's oratory and can be stored in the bookcase of your player-owned house.

Augmented Robe bottom of the First Necromancer (Ice)
Augmented Robe top of the First Necromancer (Ice)
Foot wraps of the First Necromancer (Ice)
Hand wrap of the First Necromancer (Ice)
Robe bottom of the First Necromancer (Ice)

sc: Ice dye is a type of dye rewarded from elite and master reward caskets of Treasure Trails and from the Giant Oyster.
The indigo pentagon is an item used in The Prisoner of Glouphrie created by using a minute crystal seed on the singing bowl.
Memoirs (page 7) can be obtained from excavating at the Senntisten Dig Site at the citizen remains excavation hotspot.

p: In the easternmost house in Catherby
sc: Some can be obtained from a table in the easternmost house of Catherby, or from talking to the beekeeper in his apiary west of Catherby.
It can also be purchased from the Groundskeeper for 3 gold each.

q: Islands That Once Were Turtles teleport tablet unlocked in the Waiko Reward Shop
sc: An Islands That Once Were Turtles teleport is a teletab that can be purchased for 5 chimes from Boni's Waiko Reward Shop after completing Ghosts from the Past miniquest.
A large XP lamp (Divination) is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter.
Larupia fur is an item obtained by hunting spined larupias (requires Level 31 Hunter) in the Jungle hunter area.

Players may receive larupia fur from opening a box of summoning ingredients, a possible reward from the Familiarisation Distraction and Diversion, as well as from the gamble in Soul Wars or from looting a spirit impling.

w: Crown of Seasons (Squeal of Fortune promotion)
h: Crown of Seasons (Squeal of Fortune promotion)
tx: Activities from which lush blossoms could be acquired

• Cutting and splitting arctic pines
• Cutting all free-to-play and members-only trees. (including ivy and Crystal trees)
• Cutting Jade roots in the Jadinko Lair
• Cutting timber at the Citadel woodcutting skilling plot
• Lumber Yard
nb: Crown of Seasons (Squeal of Fortune promotion)
sc: Lush blossoms are the components of the Coronet of Summer, and are won through playing Squeal of Fortune, or awarded while Woodcutting.
The number of blossoms obtained appears to be based roughly on the amount of experience gained, rather than the number of actions the player does.
Malevolent helm is tier 90 Melee power armour and it is made by combining 14 malevolent energy with a reinforcing plate, at 91 Smithing.
Marmaros platelegs is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.

tx: Calquat kegs are highly recommended, especially if the ale has matured. This creates Cider (m) (keg). Simply by collecting the ale in a keg, the value of the batch will increase by several thousand coins.
sc: Cider can be made by brewing in eastern Keldagrim or Port Phasmatys.
A medium fallen star (Ranged) is an uncommon prize from Treasure Hunter that can be redeemed for bonus experience in the Ranged skill.
2× the experience given by a medium XP lamp.
The money crest voucher is an item given to the player by Sir Renitee when they change from the money crest to the Saradomin crest for the Falador achievements.

r: Partial completion of The Mighty Fall
sc: A nearly boiled egg can be obtained after partial completion of The Mighty Fall by using an expired spin ticket on Wizard Goldberg in the Runecrafting Guild.
As part of the Mod Deg trading sequence, it may be used on Kipple Nano to obtain ruined essence, and may be fed to be a Baby Troll.
If players lose or destroy it, they may obtain a copy from Kent or Caroline.
Observation: Silence is a memory found in JasKra's chamber during Heart of Stone.
Ocean's Archer is a cosmetic override outfit available by redeeming tokens obtained from Treasure Hunter or other players.
The outfit could also be unlocked by buying the Ocean's archer override pack.
It is made by using a knife with an onion, then a tomato.
A tomato can be found in Aggie's house.
It is made by using a gold bar on a furnace, while having a cut onyx and an amulet mould in the inventory.
It is found in a crate inside the tower on the north-west side.
Poorly-cooked beast meat is a food item that can be made by using raw beast meat on a fire.
It can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It can be created at level 98 Smithing from four promethium bars.
As random events were removed on 24 October 2012, it currently serves no purpose and cannot be seen or obtained by players during normal gameplay.
It can be created by giving a red dragonhide and 20 coins to a tanner, or by using the Make Leather spell at level 83 Magic.
Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Varrock, Taverley, Canifis and the Crafting Guild.

Replica Dragon.x: Replica Dragon is a cosmetic override outfit that is unlocked by purchasing the Replica dragon plate armour pack from Solomon's General Store for 60,000 loyalty points.

Replica Infinity (Air) Bottoms.x: The Replica Infinity (Air) Bottoms are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Replica Infinity Robes pack.

sc: The rotten journal can be found by following the clues from the hooded pirate.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 10 rune bars and a rune platebody + 1, requiring 3,000 progress to complete, granting a total of 2,400 Smithing experience.
The sacred clay bow is a weapon obtained as a reward from Stealing Creation.
It can be obtained by searching the Drunken Sailor outside The Rusty Anchor pub in Port Sarim.
If lost, a replacement hat can be obtained by searching the Drunken Sailor again.
The player must obtain four different notes for the quest by killing Skeletons, Dried zombies and Scabarites north of the archaeologist camp, or Mummies to the west.

Silken top (red).x: The red silken top is part of the silken outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: Silverhawk tongues can be won on the Treasure Hunter minigame from 14 March 2014.
The slime hunter legplates are a reward from the Slime is of the Essence promotion.
The slimy egg can be obtained while fishing in the Port district or the VIP skilling area of Menaphos.
The egg can be obtained even when utilising the consume option on the fury shark outfit or while having the Bait and Switch relic active.
It can be made by bringing 2 bark and 3000 coins to Wizard Jalarast in the Wizards' Tower.

sc: The Stein is a weapon override unlocked by claiming a stein weapon token.

• Training Agility on a Manual Auto-cycle in the Empty Throne Room (this is by far the fastest method, sometimes providing both strange rocks in a matter of minutes)
Completing laps of the following courses:

• Agility Pyramid (retrieving the pyramid top counts as lap completion)
• Anachronia Agility Course (completing any section)
• Barbarian Outpost Agility Course (basic or advanced)
• Ape Atoll Agility Course
• Wilderness Agility Course
• Werewolf Agility Course (turning in the stick counts as lap completion)
• Bandos's Throne Room Agility Course
• Het's Oasis Agility Course
• Hefin Agility Course
• Dorgesh-Kaan Agility Course
Using the agility cape may help with rock collection by eliminating failure rate to pass obstacles.
sc: They can be obtained by training Agility by any of the methods listed below.
It is made by adding clean winter's grip and a misshapen claw to a vial of water.
Depending on the player's choice during the quest Field of Screams, it may be received as a quest reward; otherwise, it can be obtained by redeeming The Horsemen's Uniform token.
The price of betrayal is a book obtained while training Dungeoneering as a reward for completing a dungeon which appears by the exit door after the Unholy cursebearer is killed.
Once the book has been obtained once it is impossible to obtain it again.

Third age ranger set.x: Third age ranger set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: Toastools are a type of rare mushroom found while foraging mushroom clusters on The Islands That Once Were Turtles within the Arc region of the Wushanko Isles.
The tome of xp 2nd ed is given as a reward Veliaf Hurtz after completing the quest Legacy of Seergaze.
The blue villager robes is a legwear item that can be purchased with trading sticks from Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative.
It was once obtainable by paying 5,000 Renown from the Battle of Lumbridge to the Zamorakian quartermaster.
It can now only be obtained as a drop from inside the God Wars Dungeon.
The zephyrium battleaxe is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
